info.name: Labify API
info.description:
Tests for the Labify mid-term backend API: authentication, users, equipment, equipment rules, bookings, maintenance tickets, projects, milestones, tasks and the read-only credit balance endpoint. Labs are parked at the end and skipped for now.

HOW TO RUN
1. Start the API and confirm the baseUrl collection variable points to its port.
2. Run 00 Setup - accounts and tokens. Promote the admin candidate in PostgreSQL with: UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE email = 'admin@labify.dev'; Then rerun the final setup request.
3. Run the feature folders in the displayed checklist order: Authentication, Users, Equipment, Equipment Rules, Bookings, Maintenance Tickets, Projects, Milestones, Tasks, Credit Ledger. Skip 99 Labs (skipped for now). Run 98 Cleanup after the feature folders. Since Labs is skipped, ensure lab records already exist for the labId and labId2 collection variables before running Equipment.

Folders share collection variables for tokens and generated ids. The collection can be rerun: accounts are reused, and each run creates its own equipment records.

Credit Ledger currently tests GET /credits/me (balance and history). The API does not currently expose a route to create credit transactions, so that checklist action cannot yet be exercised through Postman.

The test script fires six booking requests for the same equipment and slot, from two different users, without waiting for each other. Exactly one must succeed (201) and the rest must be rejected (409). Anything created is deleted afterwards.
